title: Partita
program_note:
Partita is an arrangement for viola of a five-movement homage to J.S. Bach’s Sonatas and Partitas for solo violin. Although the language—tonally, harmonically, rhythmically—is quite different from Bach’s monumental works, the spirit is very much in that tradition.  Most of the music was written immediately following heart surgery in March, 2018.

Partita is about 20’30” total duration, with the individual movements approximately as shown:
1.  Allemande (3’15”)
2.  Sarabande (5’15”)
iii. Minuet in Fugue (4’30”)
1.  Gigue (simple and double) (4’30”)
2.  Courrente (3’00”)

David S. Lefkowitz
Los Angeles, CA
23 June 2018
